checks.name: schema
checks.detail: required fields missing from some records: n_test, test_base_rate, test_average_precision, test_roc_auc. Discount the checks that name them below; the checks that do not need them still answer.

checks.name: chance correction
checks.detail: records do not carry n_test, test_base_rate, so this question cannot be answered from this file. That is a property of the records, not a failure of the check.

checks.name: negative control
checks.detail: no permuted-label control supplied (--control). Without one there is no evidence the pipeline does not leak.

checks.name: pairing integrity
checks.detail: no test_label_fingerprint. Paired tests across methods cannot be verified, only assumed, and a silent mismatch is invisible.

checks.name: unit of analysis
checks.detail: 18 records = 6 configurations x ~1 seeds. Across-configuration claims have n=6, not n=18. State which n any reported p-value rests on.

checks.name: statistical power
checks.detail: records do not carry test_average_precision, n_test, test_base_rate, so this question cannot be answered from this file. That is a property of the records, not a failure of the check.

checks.name: precision floor
checks.detail: records do not carry test_average_precision, n_test, test_base_rate, so this question cannot be answered from this file. That is a property of the records, not a failure of the check.

checks.name: multiplicity
checks.detail: this file supports 18 pairwise comparisons across 6 configurations. Uncorrected, the chance of at least one spurious rejection at alpha 0.05 is about 0.60. Declare which are confirmatory, or correct (Bonferroni would be 2.78e-03).

checks.name: tuning symmetry
checks.detail: no `params` or `C` field, so it cannot be seen whether each method had hyperparameters to select.

checks.name: cross-arm comparison
checks.detail: only one arm supplied. Every figure above describes comparisons WITHIN this file. If the claim being made is against another arm, pass it with --compare or the power and multiplicity numbers describe the wrong comparison.

checks.name: kernel conditioning
checks.detail: condition number stays below 1e12 (worst 4.5e+05 over 6 sampled kernels covering 1 method(s) (hardware) on 1 seed(s)), so the dual is well determined.

checks.name: classical surrogate equivalence
checks.detail: needs training_data, refit in --hook. Fits the nearest classical kernel with no labels and runs it through your pipeline on your split; a kernel that scores what its surrogate scores is that surrogate.

checks.name: selection
checks.detail: no inner_score field, so it cannot be shown that model selection used training folds rather than the test score.

not_runnable.name: grid adequacy against a shuffled null
not_runnable.reason: needs a re-run, not a hook: the same pipeline on permuted labels with a widened grid. Widening raises the best inner score even when nothing is better, so hyperparameter edge flags never justify it on their own.
